title: 第13章 显著提升第14章 气力大增
content_zh:
;;
陈平从玉佩空间出来，头痛，身体疲惫。
他强迫自己躺下，闭上眼，却睡不着。怀里有粮，心里警惕。
这窝棚里，连耗子都能偷走糊糊。
天没亮，监工的吆喝声就响了。
陈平爬起来，动作太大，牵扯到了背后的伤，疼得他吸气。
他比别人起得早。
很早就进入了玉佩空间，吃了两把生米。
这让他的体力，会比别人好。
他跟着人群走向猪圈。
今天还是割猪草。
王管事那张脸，在晨光里显得阴沉，眼皮耷拉着扫过杂役。
陈平低着头，缩着身子。
背篓甩到肩上时，那熟悉的磨痛又来了。
他咬紧牙，没吭声。
走到那片野草地，他拿起镰刀开始割。
动作似乎比昨天利索了一点，手臂挥动没那么沉。
割下的草堆了一小堆。
他直起腰，把草往背篓里装。
装了半篓，他深吸一口气，抓住背篓带子，用力往上一提。

篓子离了地，压在他肩头。
沉。
肩膀的皮肉绷紧了。
但他站住了，没像前几天那样踉跄。
他迈开步子，往猪圈方向走。
步子不快，但每一步都踩实。
背篓带子勒进肩头的旧伤，火辣辣地疼，但他扛住了。
半篓草，背了回去，没歇脚。
王管事靠在猪圈门框上剔牙，瞥了他一眼，没说话，只是鼻子里哼了一声。
旁边一个壮汉杂役嗤笑。
“哟，陈瘸子今天能扛半筐了？昨晚偷吃了？”
陈平没理他，卸下草，转身又往野草地走。
这一次，他割得更快些。
手臂的酸痛还在，但那股温劲似乎顶在筋骨里。
他装了满满一篓草，堆得冒尖。
content_en:
;;
Chen Ping came out of the jade pendant space with a headache and physical exhaustion.
He forced himself to lie down and close his eyes, but he couldn't fall asleep. There is food in the arms and vigilance in the heart.
In this shack, even mice can steal the paste.
Before dawn, the supervisor's shouts rang out.
Chen Ping got up, but his movements were too big, causing injuries on his back, causing him to inhale in pain.
He gets up earlier than others.
I entered the Jade Pendant Space very early and ate two handfuls of uncooked rice.
This makes his physical strength better than others.
He followed the crowd to the pig pen.
Still mowing hogweed today.
Manager Wang's face looked gloomy in the morning light, and his eyelids drooped as he glanced at the servants.
Chen Ping lowered his head and shrank.
When the backpack was thrown onto my shoulders, the familiar pain came again.
He gritted his teeth and remained silent.
When he reached the wild grassland, he picked up the sickle and started mowing.
His movements seemed a little more agile than yesterday, and his arm swings were less heavy.
There was a small pile of cut grass.
He straightened up and put the grass into the basket on his back.
After filling half of the basket, he took a deep breath, grabbed the strap of the basket, and lifted it up with force.
The basket lifted off the ground and rested on his shoulders.
Shen.
The flesh of his shoulders tightened.
But he stood still and didn't stagger like he did a few days ago.
He took steps towards the pigsty.
The pace is not fast, but every step is solid.
The strap of the backpack cut into the old injury on his shoulder, causing burning pain, but he endured it.
Half a basket of grass was carried back without stopping.
Manager Wang leaned on the door frame of the pig pen and picked his teeth. He glanced at him and said nothing, just snorted.
A burly handyman next to him sneered.
"Hey, can Chen Laizi carry half the basket today? Did he eat it secretly last night?"
Chen Ping ignored him, unloaded the grass, turned around and walked back to the wild grass.
This time, he cut faster.
The pain in my arms is still there, but the warmth seems to be pressing into my bones.
He filled a basket full of grass and piled it to the top.
